calls.title: Gizmo.ai and GrowthBook
calls.summary: The discussion highlighted the critical need for cluster-level randomized experiments in GrowthBook to address Postdoc's limitations in treating users independently. Louis Vines emphasized this as a core blocker for social feature testing, which affects engagement metrics such as referral rates per user. The team acknowledged the cost-saving potential of using GrowthBook’s BigQuery integration compared to Postdoc's event charges, with plans to validate clustering feasibility before commitment. Emphasis was placed on aligning experimentation efforts with quarterly company goals to drive key metrics, with James Shannon confirming GrowthBook’s capabilities in supporting these needs. A trial on existing BigQuery data was proposed, with support from GrowthBook’s team and next steps set to discuss contract options.
calls.keywords: cluster experiments, randomized controlled trials, data warehouse, BigQuery, feature flags, cost savings
